NSCameraUsageDescription: For a profile photo, a photo in a chat, or a verification selfie. Every photo is checked before it reaches anyone else, and verification selfies are deleted straight after.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: For a profile photo, a photo in a chat, or your business listing. Profile and listing photos are seen by other travelers, a chat photo only by the people in it.
NSMotionUsageDescription: Samewhere does not track motion. Apple requires this notice because a software library the app is built with refers to the motion tools.
